messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=az3-serving severity=critical - metric=controlplane.heartbeat.thump rate=high -> paging rotation dmitri_oncall

pagerduty: Alert: az3-serving - controlplane heartbeat oscillation detected. Notified: dmitri_oncall -> will escalate if unacked in 2m

dmitri_oncall: acked. I'm taking this. looking at control plane heartbeats + routing stats.

max_infra: seeing a big GPU pressure event in az3: autoscaler backed off (OOMs on worker pods), batch queue length spiked 4x. nodes at 92% mem.

lia_sre: joining. any customer-impact reports yet?

sarah_dev: we've got multiple small customer complaints (EU) - ~30% 5xx rate on text-generation endpoints hitting az3. Quick dashboard: error spike started ~5m before page.

dmitri_oncall: controlplane heartbeats are oscillating. KV cache eviction rate is through the roof, prefix-cache thrash. I suspect routing and cache stress causing token generation slowdowns -> 5xxs.

max_infra: also see a network egress queue bump on the infra side for az3. Might be a transient NIC degen on a subset of hosts.

lia_sre: immediate mitigations proposed: 1) enable routing fallback from az3 -> az2 for production routes, 2) temporarily throttle per-route rps for az3 to protect control plane, 3) scale emergency GPU capacity in az3 if autoscaler won't keep up. I'll open PD bridge. @support-team pls stand by for status page text.

incident-bot: Runbook snippet - fallback activation (short):
```
# activate routing fallback from az3 to az2 (immediate)
redwood-cli routing set-fallback --from az3 --to az2 --policy immediate
# emergency scale up az3 GPUs (best-effort)
redwood-cli infra scale --zone az3 --gpus +8 --priority emergency
# apply per-route throttle (protect control plane)
redwood-cli config set --route "/v1/generate" --zone az3 --throttle 200rps
```

dmitri_oncall: running the fallback now. will post outputs.

max_infra: routing command returned: 202 Accepted -> fallback enabled, traffic diverting to az2. infra scale request submitted to provisioning queue (ETA ~90s).

lia_sre: PD bridge created. Bridge URL: https://pd.bridge/az3-1765432111 (posted to channel) - inviting support and comms.

sarah_dev: early signal: error rate starting to drop (now ~12%). Latency for some requests to az2 is +120-200ms. Customers on dedicated stacks pinned to az3 may see higher tail latency.

dmitri_oncall: applying per-route throttle to 200 rps for az3 to reduce thrash. Also kicking off KV cache warmup on az2 mirror.

max_infra: infra scale completed: +8 GPUs provisioned in az3, pods gradually coming up. OOMKills decreasing on workers.

lia_sre: current impact summary for comms: Hosted API clients (eu-west) saw 5xx spike ~5-12m, now reduced to ~5-10% above baseline. Dedicated customers pinned to az3 may see increased latency until fallback stabilizes.

support-bot: Draft status page update: "Investigating an outage affecting inference in az3. Some requests may return 5xx or elevated latency. Teams are activating routing fallbacks and scaling capacity. We'll update in 15 minutes or as new info becomes available." Approve? :eyes:

sarah_dev: approve the draft, pls add expected ETA ~20m for full stabilization.

lia_sre: added ETA note. Notifying comms.

dmitri_oncall: monitoring: KV eviction rate trending down, prefixcache hitrate improving on az2. Control plane heartbeats still noisy but within acceptable SLO after throttling.

pagerduty: dmitri_oncall acknowledged at 1m. Alert escalated to lia_sre per rotation rules.

lia_sre: we should keep the fallback in place for 30m and watch for risk of oscillation when we route back. I'll coordinate a controlled rollback once metrics stable for 15m.

max_infra: note - autoscaler bug surfaced during this event (scale cooldown mis-evaluated). Filed infra ticket INF-3874 for postmortem.

dmitri_oncall: adding incident tags: az3, routing-fallback, kv-eviction, autoscaler-cooldown. Will capture timeline for postmortem.

lia_sre: status: declaring incident Sev2. If we see re-escalation / global impact escalate to Sev1. PD bridge will remain open.

support-bot: customer comms pushed to status page and flagged for premium customers. CS notified.

dmitri_oncall: quick note for handoff - I'll be on-call for another ~40m, then handing to night rotation @alex_night. Lia will continue to watch the bridge. Any objections?

alex_night: I'll pick up at handoff. Thx.

lia_sre: handoff plan: keep fallback active, monitor errors & control plane heartbeats, coordinate rollback only after 15m stable metrics (5xx < 2x baseline, eviction rate normalized). If we see any regression, escalate immediately.

dmitri_oncall: agreed. adding the mitigation commands + links to logs in the incident doc. Will close thread after handoff and final status update. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident thread annotated: mitigation=routing-fallback, scale=az3+8gpus, severity=sev2, postmortem_required=true

lia_sre: final channel update before handoff: errors down to ~3-5% above baseline, latency elevated for a small subset (+120ms). Moving to monitoring-only. Handoff to @alex_night in 2m.

alex_night: ack - will monitor overnight and will reopen if anything degrades.

lia_sre: handing off. Signing out.
